result.topic_en: The page states that the roots of the characteristic cubic of a positive ternary quadratic form give the principal axes of an ellipsoid circumscribed about the associated parallelepiped, then gives coordinates of the vertices of the regular icosahedron, expressed via fifth roots of unity ρ.
result.transcription:
Die drei Wurzeln der Gleichung
$0 = p^3 - pp(a+a'+a'') + p(A+A'+A'') - D$
[-wo-] stellen die drei Hauptaxen eines {+um+} desjenige Parallelepipedum [-be-]{+ge+}schriebenen Ellipsoids vor,
auf welches sich die ternäre [-positive-] Form
$\begin{pmatrix} a, a', a'' \\ b, b', b'' \end{pmatrix}$ mit Adiuncta $\begin{pmatrix} A, A', A'' \\ B, B', B'' \end{pmatrix}$ und Determ. $= [-+-] D$
bezieht

Die Coordinaten der Ecken des regelmässigen [-Dodecaeders-] {+Icosaeders+}
(eingeschrieben in Kugel Halbmesser [-= 1)-] [-...-] $\sqrt{(aa+bb)}$
$0 \quad \pm a \quad \pm b$
$\pm b \quad 0 \quad \pm a$
$\pm a \quad \pm b \quad 0$
wo $b = a \cdot \frac{\sqrt5 - 1}{2} = 2a\cos 72^\circ$
$a = a \cdot \frac{\sqrt5+1}{2}$
$aa+bb = (2a \sin 36)^2$
Also Halbmesser d. Kugel $= \sqrt{[-...-]5}$ Also $\rho^5 = 1$ gesetzt
$b = a(\rho + \rho^4)$
$\sqrt{(aa+bb)} = \frac{a(\rho^2 - \rho^3)}{i} = \frac{5a}{\rho - \rho^4}$
$0 \quad \pm(\rho - \rho^4) \quad \pm(\rho\rho - \rho^3)$
$\pm(\rho\rho - \rho^3) \quad 0 \quad \pm(\rho - \rho^4)$
$\pm(\rho - \rho^4) \quad \pm(\rho\rho - \rho^3) \quad \pm 0$
Halbmesser $= 5i$
$0 \quad \rho + 2\rho\rho - 2\rho^3 - \rho^4 \quad 2\rho - \rho\rho + \rho^3 - 2\rho^4$
$2\rho - \rho\rho + \rho^3 + 2\rho^4 \quad 0 \quad \rho + 2\rho\rho - 2\rho^3 - \rho^4$
$\rho + 2\rho\rho - 2\rho^3 - \rho^4 \quad 2\rho - \rho\rho + \rho^3 - 2\rho^4 \quad 0$
Noch zierlicher Halbmesser $= \sqrt5$
Die 12 Punkte sind, durch $k$ die Einheit der dritten Coordinate bezeichnet
$\pm(2\rho^n + k)$
und $\pm \sqrt5 . k = \pm(\rho - \rho\rho - \rho^3 + \rho^4)k$

methods.what: Roots of the characteristic cubic of a ternary quadratic form give the principal axes of an ellipsoid associated with the form's parallelepiped
Coordinates of the regular icosahedron vertices as cyclic permutations of (0, ±a, ±b) with golden-ratio relation
Expressing icosahedron coordinates via fifth roots of unity ρ (ρ^5=1)
Radius expressed through roots of unity
Icosahedron's 12 vertices as ±(2ρ^n + k) and ±√5·k with sphere radius √5

items.english: The three roots of the equation 0 = p^3 − p^2(a+a'+a'') + p(A+A'+A'') − D represent the three principal axes of an ellipsoid circumscribed about that parallelepiped to which the ternary form (a,a',a''; b,b',b'') with adjoint (A,A',A''; B,B',B'') and determinant D refers.
